channel.title: Medical College of Wisconsin – Recent News
channel.description: Latest news from the Medical College of Wisconsin

item.title: Medical College of Wisconsin Announces New President and CEO
item.description: The Medical College of Wisconsin (MCW) today announced that Shekar N. Kurpad, MD, PhD, FEL ‘01, has been unanimously appointed as the institution’s seventh president and chief executive officer (CEO), effective July 1, 2026.

item.title: Kratom Use is Surging in the US with Life-changing Consequences
item.description: A new study published in Addiction has found that kratom use – measured as kratom exposures reported to US poison centers – and cases of severe medical outcomes linked to kratom use have surged in the US over the past decade.

item.title: Michels Family Donates $27 Million to the Medical College of Wisconsin to Expand Personalized Cancer Care, Accelerate Cancer Research
item.description: The Michels transformational gift will enable the Cancer Center to bring additional world-class precision oncology talent to MCW, enhance technological infrastructure, train and develop the next generation of cancer scientists, innovators, and entrepreneurs, and expand access to precision...

item.title: Medical College of Wisconsin Celebrates Groundbreaking for New On-Campus Student Housing Complex
item.description: During an official groundbreaking ceremony of the Medical College of Wisconsin’s first student housing project on July 28, Shekar Kurpad, MD, PhD, MCW president and CEO, announced the building’s name: Trailmark at MCW.

item.title: Medical College of Wisconsin Announces Dean of the School of Medicine
item.description: Brett Kissela, MD, GME ‘96, MS, named Executive Vice President for Health Affairs and Dean of the Medical College of Wisconsin School of Medicine.

item.title: Chad Carlson, MD, Appointed Chair of the MCW Department of Neurology
item.description: The Medical College of Wisconsin (MCW) is pleased to announce Chad Carlson, MD, FAAN, FAES, interim chair of neurology and professor of neurology, has been appointed Chair of the Department of Neurology.

item.title: Froedtert & the Medical College of Wisconsin Cancer Network is First to Offer Proton Therapy in Wisconsin
item.description: Revolutionary cancer treatment uses protons for precision targeting.

item.title: Medical College of Wisconsin to Lead Landmark Multi-Center Clinical Trial in Traumatic Brain Injury Rehabilitation
item.description: The Medical College of Wisconsin (MCW) is leading a new multi-center clinical trial to evaluate an interdisciplinary rehabilitation model for military veterans and first responders with mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) and co-occurring disorders such as depression, anxiety, and post-traumatic...

item.title: Biotech Company Co-founded by MCW Researcher Begins Phase II Trial of First Pepsin Inhibitor for Reflux Disease
item.description: The trial is led by Nikki Johnston, PhD, professor of otolaryngology and communication sciences and microbiology and immunology at the Medical College of Wisconsin and co-founder of N-Zyme Biomedical.

item.title: MCW-Green Bay, Prevea Health Retain Physician Talent Locally
item.description: MCW-Green Bay has trained the next generation of physicians in northeast Wisconsin, a pipeline that has brought new practitioners to Prevea.
